verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean clause is residual_flatness, a field of the structure LocalPaper.Properties (structure fields are not separate entries in the declaration index, so the containing structure is cited with the clause's line). Term by term: |·|_m is ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m ·‖ of the residual as a function on space-time, which covers the paper's mixed ∂^α_x ∂^b_t of Theorem 3.1(iii); O(q^N) is ∃ C ≥ 0, ∃ δ > 0 with the bound C * q^r for q < δ, with C and δ allowed to depend on (m, r, X) exactly as the paper's O allows; the Lean exponent ranges over all real r ≥ 0, which subsumes the paper's natural N. One restriction is present in the Lean and absent from the bare display: the bound is asserted only on the cone radialEnergy w.2 / q ≤ X. That is not a weakening of what the paper means — the paper's own Theorem 3.1(iii) carries the same restriction (constants C_{α,b,N,X₁} for 0 ≤ X ≤ X₁) — and the unrestricted reading is recovered in two lines: apply residual_flatness at X = Xext to get the bound on {q < δ, radialEnergy/q ≤ Xext}, and apply the exterior clause, which gives residual = 0 on {q < qstar, Xext ≤ radialEnergy/q}; with δ' = min(δ, qstar) the bound holds on the whole local domain {q < δ'}. The m = 0 case of that gluing is immediate; for m ≥ 1 the two regions are glued by the fields agreeing with the exact exterior heat field there, which the exterior clause asserts pointwise rather than as a germ — this is the one step I state as an argument rather than as something the Lean packages. The identification of u_loc, p_loc with the Lean's selectedRawVelocity / LocalPotentialRebundle.pressure is made by properties_of_schedule.
